text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer-san. The refreshing 
morning breeze feels wonderful today.
choice_data_list: Looks like you got some proper rest.
Looks like you got some proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Yesterday I went hiking in the 
mountains from morning, and was able to 
listen closely to the voice of nature.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The rustling sound of tree leaves, the 
melodious songs of little birds, a breeze 
sweeping through carrying the scent of the 
earth—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If I could, I found myself wishing I could 
stay in the mountains forever.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While thinking that wouldn't do, I felt 
relieved seeing that Yamanin Zephyr seemed 
to have gotten a proper rest.
